purpose: German frequency-priority seed for the first RhymeLab enrichment milestone

license.name: CC BY
license.attribution: Leipzig Corpora Collection / Deutscher Wortschatz, Leipzig University

ranking_policy.method: sum raw occurrence counts for each case-sensitive surface form across the three 1M-sentence corpora; rank descending; retain first 10,000 accepted forms
ranking_policy.reason: mix recent news, encyclopedic prose and German web text to reduce single-genre frequency bias

notes: The Leipzig download page lists 1M German corpora for News 2024, Wikipedia 2021 and Germany Web 2021.
The raw archives are not committed to Git. The bootstrap workflow computes their SHA-256 hashes and retains only the derived seed/checksum metadata as an artifact.
Before the seed is declared canonical, copy the observed hashes back into a new immutable manifest revision rather than silently changing an already-used snapshot.
